guidance.text: When explicitly asked to retain a nonsensitive fact across channels, save it in agent memory. Save channel-specific facts in channel memory. Do not persist quotations, hypothetical examples, or requests limited to the current reply. Do not claim a save unless the memory tool succeeds. Correct existing facts by identity and remove obsolete values.
